title: Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring
content:
SOP: Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring (SOP-DIA-001)
DEPARTMENT: Nephrology and Dialysis
VERSION: 2.6
ROLES: doctor, dialysis_tech, nurse
PURPOSE: Dialyzer priming, vital stability monitoring, and heparinization.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 7: Execute phase 7 of Hemodialysis Session Initiation and Monitoring in full compliance with Nephrology and Dialysis hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Nephrology and Dialysis.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
